item.title: Google, Meta Addiction Lawsuit Faces Jury Split After Week of Deliberations
item.description: A jury remains divided in a landmark lawsuit against Google and Meta over social media addiction, delaying a verdict that could impact similar cases nationwide.

item.title: OnlyFans CEO Leonid Radvinsky Dies of Cancer, Company Announces
item.description: OnlyFans CEO Leonid Radvinsky dies at 43 after a battle with cancer, leaving behind a $4.7B digital empire.

item.title: Iran Reportedly Charging Millions To Ships To Go Through Strait Of Hormuz Citing Cost Of War
item.description: The Iranian regime is charging ship operators $2 million to allow them to go through the Strait of Hormuz, a key waterway through which about 20% of the world's energy goes through, citing the cost of the war with the U.S. and Israel, according to a new report.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Declares 'We Have Achieved AGI,' Sparking Debate Over Definition
item.description: Nvidia Corp. CEO Jensen Huang stunned the technology world Monday by declaring that artificial general intelligence — long considered the holy grail of AI — has already been achieved, telling podcaster Lex Fridman "I think it's now. I think we've achieved AGI."
